projects.title: Nyishi speech-to-IPA
projects.stage: Smoke checks complete · validation CER next
projects.notes: My bachelor's thesis project: a reproducible speech recognition pipeline for Nyishi Narration data using IPA transcriptions and IPA-Whisper. The work covers audio curation, careful transcript handling, and speaker/session separation.
projects.status_detail: Splits are frozen; processor and model smoke checks are complete. A zero-shot validation CER baseline is next, before fine-tuning and final test evaluation. The engineering checks are not a held-out accuracy result.

projects.title: VoiceEnterprise
projects.notes: An enterprise RAG and voice prototype bringing together hybrid retrieval, cited answers, and a spoken interface. I'm interested in how retrieval choices, evidence handling, and latency affect the system people actually use.
projects.status_detail: Prototype work focused on retrieval, evaluation, and the path from a spoken question to a grounded response.

projects.title: My ChatGPT Skills
projects.notes: A growing collection of reusable AI workflows: prompt optimization, visual explanations, idea refinement, research reports, and active-recall tutoring. This is where I turn useful ways of working into repeatable tools.
projects.status_detail: An ongoing collection refined through use, with a focus on clearer instructions and useful outputs.

projects.title: BeyondBot TDS Review Agent
projects.notes: A Python CLI prototype combining LLM-led investigation with deterministic calculations, evidence validation, and voucher-level coverage tracking.
projects.status_detail: Its published evaluation covers part of the ledger. This is a prototype with explicit review limits, not a completed financial review.
